author: Pixelastic
subject: refactor(pagination): First try on the BEM naming of a widget
bodyLines: I added BEM naming to the pagination widget. The generated markup
Everytime I add a `BEM` class, one can add its own set of custom
classes through the `cssClasses` object config in the widget.
A default `pagination.css` file is provided but currently only
includes the `visibility:hidden` styling of disabled elements. The
demo styling is thus done through bootstrap classes.
I quite happy with the end result. I also simplified the existing code
in the process and moved all default attributes in the widget (instead
I'm submitting the PR to get feedback and then I'll update the docs
and maybe add some default styling not from Bootstrap.
